How VIP Days work

1. PRE-WORK

Upload any brand assets you may have to our shared drive and answer your pre-VIP Day Questionnaire.

2. ALIGNMENT CALL

We’ll meet for a 45-minute strategy call before your VIP Day to review your pre-work, align on priorities, and make a game plan.

3. VIP Day 🤩

We show up caffeinated and spend the day focused entirely on you, with workshops or feedback built in as needed.

4. THE DAY AFTER +

Every VIP Day includes one hour of “fix-it” time for any final tweaks or edits within the following week.

HEYYYY SUNSHINE

This is perfect for you if…

  • You have a project that you need done ASAP

  • You have an ever-growing to-do list and not enough time or manpower to get it done

  • You can commit to getting your pre-work done and being available the day of to move things forward

  • You have your brand and business defined — know who your audience is, what your offers are, what your value proposition is, have key messaging, and know what you do (and don’t) like

THE TIMELINE

•

THE TIMELINE •

Pre-work

Upload any brand assets you may have within our shared drive and complete your pre-VIP Day questionnaire based on your specific project.

Alignment Call

We have a 45 min phone call after you complete your homework and before your VIP day to go over your priorities and make sure we’re on the same page about how your VIP day will flow.

9am — We begin working

We roll up our sleeves and get to work.

Your involvement

Your involvement depends on the project. You won’t need to pause your whole day, but you should be available for quick feedback, questions, or any pre-planned workshops.

5pm — End of our day

We deliver what we have and you get to sleep on it.

Fix it time

For every VIP Day, you get 1 hour of “fix it” time to be used within one week of your final VIP Day. This allows us to implement any tweaks or make any edits after you’ve had time to really sit with what we’ve done.

Delivery

We’ll hand over all final files and site access, host any brand or audit presentations, and record any tutorials you may need.

Post VIP Day Support

You have 30 days of Slack support should you have any questions.

PROJECT: website redesign, copywriting & brand design refinement

Average Project Length = 3 VIP Days

  • Day 1: Simple brand positioning and messaging

  • Day 2: Simple brand identity — colors, fonts, type-based logo & submarks

  • Day 3: 1-2 page Squarespace website — including copy and design

Larger projects can VARY

For larger, more complex projects — like merging websites, managing multiple brands, developing a deeper brand strategy, or involving more stakeholders — we’ll scope the work and recommend the number of VIP Days needed.

How many VIP Days will you need?

We’re built for speed, but we refuse to sacrifice quality. That’s why most projects require a minimum of three VIP Days to get things right.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

•

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS •

Major 🚀 Tom to Ground Control —
I’ve Got Questions

  • It’s all about time. We know that time is short, margins are tight, and you need to get business going — yesterday. For those who need to move fast, opting for a VIP day allows you to get things done instantly rather than having to wait.   

    PROS

    – Fast turnaround

    – Affordable

    – Great for businesses with small (or no) marketing teams

    – Great for bootstrapped startups

    CONS

    – Everything you will get will be high quality — however — there is a benefit to slowing down. For instance, having more time for your brand and design strategy allows for more collaboration with a broader audience which can affect the overall direction of the brand

    – You won’t get as many rounds of revisions for your copy or design — time just won’t allow it

  • We’ve been doing this for a while now and have a good understanding of what is and isn’t possible, but we’re still human. If, for some reason, we underestimate the amount of time that is needed or on the rare occasion that our dog eats one of our computers, we will let you know ASAP.

    Most projects are at least 3 days total. If your project needs more days, we’ll discuss it upfront or offer doing any additional work at our hourly rate.

  • No. There’s no need to put your life on hold during your VIP Day. However, you will want to be in a place where you can answer any questions or give feedback periodically.

    For some projects, we may request that you join us for a workshop. IN that case, we will prep you for the workshop and plan it on a day that works best for you.

  • If there’s time for small changes at the end of the day, we’re more than happy to make those for you. 

    If you want additional changes after the allotted time:

    – If it’s regarding the work we completed during your VIP day, we can make those changes for you at our hourly rate of $125

    – If the changes you are asking for are more than small changes, we will have to reconsider the project which could look like another full or half VIP Day.

  • Absolutely not! We don’t do anything if it’s not to the best of our ability. We’re allergic to half-assed work — no joke.  

    This is another reason why most projects are a minimum of 3 days. A lot of the clients we work with are looking for a brand and website combo. We know what it takes to make you pop, so we plan for that vs trying to cut corners and squeeze everything into one day.
